description: This file defines the DotNetSerializableCodec class, a serializer implementation for types implementing the ISerializable pattern within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It handles serialization and deserialization of such objects, managing type information, object references, and calling appropriate callbacks during the process.

classes.name: DotNetSerializableCodec
classes.description: Serializer for types implementing ISerializable, handling serialization/deserialization with support for reference tracking, type info, and callbacks.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field of an object, handling value types and reference types appropriately.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from the reader, handling reference tracking, type info, and fallback for exceptions.

methods.name: ReadFallbackException
methods.description: Handles deserialization of unknown exception types as a fallback.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reconstructs an object from serialized data, including invoking callbacks and managing object references.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes an object implementing ISerializable, including exception types, callbacks, and fields.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for serialization by this codec.
